india.name: "NOT FOR MEDICINAL USE" missing
india.citation: FSS (Health Supplements, Nutraceuticals, Food for Special Dietary Use…) Regulations, 2016: "NOT FOR MEDICINAL USE" on the label
india.explanation: Health supplements and nutraceuticals sold in India must carry the words "NOT FOR MEDICINAL USE" prominently.
india.advice: Add "NOT FOR MEDICINAL USE" prominently on the label.

india.name: Recommended daily usage or warning missing
india.citation: FSS (Health Supplements, Nutraceuticals…) Regulations, 2016: recommended usage and a warning not to exceed it
india.explanation: No recommended daily usage, or warning not to exceed it, was found.
india.advice: Add the recommended daily usage and "Do not exceed the recommended daily usage".

fix.line: Recommended usage: [amount and frequency]. Do not exceed the recommended daily usage.

us.name: Dietary supplement disclaimer missing
us.citation: 21 CFR 101.93(c): structure/function claims on dietary supplements need the FDA disclaimer (DSHEA)
us.explanation: The label makes a structure/function claim ("supports…", "promotes…") but doesn't carry the required FDA disclaimer.
us.advice: Add the disclaimer, linked by an asterisk to each claim.

fix.line: *These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

india.name: "NOT FOR MEDICINAL USE" missing
india.citation: FSS (Health Supplements, Nutraceuticals, Food for Special Dietary Use…) Regulations, 2016 (sports nutrition is covered): "NOT FOR MEDICINAL USE"
india.explanation: Protein and sports nutrition products regulated as health supplements in India must carry "NOT FOR MEDICINAL USE".
india.advice: Add "NOT FOR MEDICINAL USE" prominently on the label.

india.name: Recommended daily usage or warning missing
india.citation: FSS (Health Supplements, Nutraceuticals…) Regulations, 2016: recommended usage and a warning not to exceed it
india.explanation: No recommended daily usage, or warning not to exceed it, was found.
india.advice: Add the recommended daily usage and "Do not exceed the recommended daily usage".

fix.line: Recommended usage: [amount and frequency]. Do not exceed the recommended daily usage.

india.name: Caffeine warning missing
india.citation: FSS (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations: caffeinated beverages must say they are not recommended for children, pregnant or lactating women, and persons sensitive to caffeine
india.explanation: The drink contains caffeine but doesn't carry the caffeine warning.

fix.line: Contains caffeine. Not recommended for children, pregnant or lactating women, persons sensitive to caffeine.

us.name: Juice percentage not declared
us.citation: 21 CFR 101.30: a beverage that says it contains juice must declare the percentage of juice
us.explanation: The label mentions juice but doesn't state the percentage of juice, e.g. "Contains 10% juice".
us.advice: Add "Contains [n]% juice" near the top of the information panel.

india.name: Importer name and address missing
india.citation: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6 and FSS (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020: importer's name, address and FSSAI licence on imported food
india.explanation: Imported food must name the importer and give their address; the FSSAI licence number must be the importer's.
india.advice: Add "Imported by: [importer name and address]" with the importer's FSSAI licence number.

us.name: Country of origin missing
us.citation: 19 CFR 134.11: imported articles must be marked with the English name of the country of origin
us.explanation: Imported food must say which country it comes from, e.g. "Product of Italy".

india.name: Multi-pack contents not declared
india.citation: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011: multi-piece and combination packages declare the number of pieces, the net quantity of each and the total
india.explanation: No "N units × quantity" declaration was found, e.g. "Contents: 4 x 25 g = 100 g". A multi-pack must say how many units it holds and how much each one contains.

fix.line: Contents: [number of units] x [quantity per unit] = [total net quantity]

india.name: One MRP for the whole multi-pack
india.citation: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011: retail sale price of a multi-piece or combination package
india.explanation: Confirm the outer pack shows one MRP for the whole multi-pack. If the units inside are also sold on their own, each needs its own full label and MRP.

india.name: Inner units not marked "Not for retail sale"
india.citation: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011: units of a multi-piece package not meant for separate sale
india.explanation: Inner units that aren't fully labelled for sale on their own are usually marked "Not for retail sale separately", so they can't be sold loose.
india.advice: Only needed if the inner units don't carry their own full label.

fix.line: Inner units: Not for retail sale separately

us.name: Multiunit package contents not declared
us.citation: 21 CFR 101.105(s): a multiunit retail package declares the number of units, the quantity of each unit and the total quantity
us.explanation: No "N units × quantity" declaration was found, e.g. "6 bars, 1.4 oz (40 g) each. Net wt. 8.4 oz (240 g)".
us.advice: State the number of units, the net quantity of each, and the total net quantity.

fix.line: Contents: [number of units] x [ounces per unit] oz ([grams per unit] g). Net wt. [total ounces] oz ([total grams] g)

us.name: Inner units sold separately need their own labels
us.explanation: Confirm whether the units inside are ever sold on their own. If they are, each needs its own full label, including net quantity.
